functional_requirements.title: Centralized 4D Trajectory Optimization

functional_requirements.title: Command Downlink with QoS 0 Guarantee

functional_requirements.title: Offline Failsafe Mode Activation
functional_requirements.description: Watchdog timer per drone_id: if no valid MAVLink HEARTBEAT for 500 ms, ground system publishes EMERGENCY_LANDING mission to Redis; drone-side ROS2 node (pre-loaded) executes immediate RTL (Return-To-Launch) using onboard EKF3 IMU+GPS fusion without ground link.

non_functional_requirements.title: End-to-End Telemetry Latency

non_functional_requirements.title: Deterministic Failsafe Switchover
non_functional_requirements.description: Ground-to-drone failsafe command issued ≤ 500 ms after last HEARBEAT; drone begins RTL maneuver ≤ 1 s after link loss without ground connectivity.

non_functional_requirements.title: Horizontal Separation Assurance

non_functional_requirements.description: One FastAPI + ROS2 instance sustains 50 concurrent drones at 10 Hz telemetry + 1 Hz command downlink with CPU ≤ 70 % on 8-core x86_64.

functional_requirements.title: ESP32-C3 Microclimate Sampling & LoRaWAN Uplink
functional_requirements.description: Each ESP32-C3 node shall sample MLX90640 thermal camera (32x24 pixels) at 4 Hz and ambient temperature via onboard sensor, package payload as CBOR {node_id, timestamp_ms, temp_c, thermal_frame[768]}, and transmit via SX1262 LoRaWAN (SF9, BW125kHz, CR 4/5) to Raspberry Pi 4 gateway within 500 ms of acquisition.

functional_requirements.title: Raspberry Pi 4 Gateway Freeze Detection & Actuation Command
functional_requirements.description: Gateway shall aggregate node payloads, compute per-node 30-second rolling minimum temperature, trigger dual-stage propane ignition relay command (GPIO 17/27 HIGH for 500ms then 2000ms) via MQTT to target node when any node reports temp_c <= 0.0C for 2 consecutive samples, and log event to Firebase Realtime DB under /frost_events/{node_id}/{timestamp}.

functional_requirements.title: Dual-Stage Propane Ignition Relay Safety Sequence
functional_requirements.description: ESP32-C3 actuator node shall execute ignition sequence: Stage 1 - open solenoid valve (relay K1, GPIO 17) for 500ms, verify flame via MLX90640 ROI delta > 15C within 2s; Stage 2 - energize main burner (relay K2, GPIO 27) for 2000ms; immediate lockout (both relays LOW) and Firebase alert /safety_lockout/{node_id} if flame verification fails or gas pressure sensor (ADS1115) reads < 0.8 bar.

functional_requirements.title: Thermal Map Streaming to React Dashboard
functional_requirements.description: Gateway shall publish interpolated 50-acre thermal map (100x100 grid, bilinear from node positions) to Firebase /thermal_map/live every 5 seconds; React dashboard shall subscribe via WebSocket, render WebGL heatmap overlay on orchard GIS tiles, and display per-node status badges (OK/FROST/HEATING/LOCKOUT) with <15s end-to-end latency from sensor sample.

functional_requirements.title: Solar/Battery Power Management & Deep Sleep
functional_requirements.description: ESP32-C3 nodes shall enter deep sleep (10 uA) between 4 Hz sampling cycles, wake via RTC timer, maintain 18650 LiFePO4 (3.2V, 6Ah) charge via 5W MPPT solar charger (CN3791), and transmit battery SOC % in each LoRaWAN uplink; gateway shall flag nodes with SOC < 20% in Firebase /node_health/{node_id}.

non_functional_requirements.title: LoRaWAN Link Budget & Latency at -20C

test-nebius-migration-project.summary: Centralized ground control system for autonomous drone delivery fleet. Ingests MAVLink telemetry via FastAPI WebSockets into Redis Streams, computes conflict-free 4D trajectories using ROS2 RRT*-Connect planner with spatio-temporal occupancy grid, downlinks commands with QoS 0 guarantees, and activates deterministic offline failsafe (RTL) within 500 ms of heartbeat loss. Single-node architecture targets 50 drones at 10 Hz with sub-100 ms P99 latency.

agroshield-frost-guard.summary: Distributed frost protection system for 50-acre orchard using 200 ESP32-C3 sensor/actuator nodes with MLX90640 thermal cameras communicating via LoRaWAN (SX1262) to a central Raspberry Pi 4 edge gateway. Gateway runs FastAPI/Mosquitto for real-time freeze detection, commands dual-stage propane ignition relays on actuator nodes, streams interpolated thermal maps to Firebase Realtime DB, and serves React dashboard via WebSocket. All nodes solar/battery powered for 6+ months at -20C.

waste2sheild-1790342155470.summary: Waste2Shield prototype architecture centered on an ESP32-S3 orchestrating a shred-to-panel cycle: a 3D-printed single-shaft shredder feeds flakes into an aluminum mold where a cartridge heater and linear actuator execute a PID-controlled thermal compression profile. On-board sensors (MAX6675 thermocouple, HX711 load cell, MPU6050 IMU, INA219 current monitor) stream CBOR telemetry via MQTT/Wi-Fi to Firebase Realtime Database, consumed by a React 18/Tailwind/Chart.js SPA. Cycle termination triggers servo-assisted mold opening, stepper ejection, and NFC tag writing for batch traceability.

test-a-clean-pipeline.summary: Autonomous dual-axis solar tracker built around an ESP32-S3 running FreeRTOS. The firmware partitions real-time motor control, sun-position tracking, and ultra-low-power deep-sleep into dedicated FreeRTOS tasks. Telemetry and OTA commands flow over MQTT (Wi-Fi) to a FastAPI/PostgreSQL cloud backend. Hardware includes DRV8825 stepper drivers, AS5600 magnetic encoders on SPI, DS3231 RTC, and MOSFET load switches with RC-sequenced gating for shoot-through protection. OTA reliability is hardened by an external TPL5010 watchdog and boot-counter rollback logic. Architecture now addresses SPI bus contention via lock-free dual-CS DMA driver and formalizes MQTT schema ownership with CI-enforced validation gates.

data_flow.description: DS3231 RTC alarm wakes ESP32-S3 from deep-sleep; firmware enables motor MOSFET load switch, waits 1 ms, then enables Wi-Fi MOSFET (RC-delayed sequencing prevents 5 V rail spikes).
Sun-position task reads RTC time, computes solar vector (SPA algorithm), reads AS5600 encoders via Lock-Free SPI Driver (DMA, dual CS), calculates azimuth/elevation error.

Motor control tasks (100 ms cycle) issue step/dir pulses to DRV8825 drivers to null error; Lock-Free SPI Driver guarantees encoder reads <20 µs each via DMA, preventing step-loss; motor tasks kick TPL5010 watchdog after both reads complete.
Telemetry task assembles JSON (angles, motor currents, battery/panel V/I) per frozen Schema v1.0, publishes to MQTT topic tracker/<id>/telemetry (QoS 0) every 30 s.
FastAPI validates MQTT payload against Schema v1.0, commits to PostgreSQL telemetry table; REST API serves historical data and accepts config updates.

On OTA command (QoS 1), firmware downloads new binary via HTTPS, writes to inactive OTA partition, verifies Ed25519 signature, increments boot-counter in NVS, sets boot flag, and reboots; TPL5010 watchdog (30 s timeout) forces rollback if application fails to kick within 5 s of boot.

architecture_decisions.decision: Partition firmware into four dedicated FreeRTOS tasks (motor control ×2, sun tracking, telemetry/OTA) plus tickless idle hook.
architecture_decisions.reason: Deterministic 100 ms motor loops and 60 s sun-tracking require hard real-time isolation from network stack and power-management logic.

architecture_decisions.decision: Use DS3231 RTC alarm interrupt as sole wake-up source for 60 s tracking cycle; gate Wi-Fi and motor power with RC-delayed MOSFET load switches (100 µs dead-time) and sequenced enable order (motors first, Wi-Fi after 1 ms; disable reverse).
architecture_decisions.reason: Achieves <20 µA idle draw by keeping ESP32-S3 in deep-sleep 99.8 % of time; RC delay and sequencing eliminate negative voltage spikes on 5 V rail that cause brown-out resets.

architecture_decisions.decision: Select 1/16 microstepping on DRV8825 to balance torque, encoder resolution (0.022°/step), and step-rate within 100 ms FreeRTOS cycle.
architecture_decisions.reason: 1/256 microstepping exceeds max step frequency at 240 MHz; 1/16 yields ±0.5° encoder quantization, meeting ±1° tracking accuracy with margin.

architecture_decisions.decision: Implement Lock-Free Dual-CS SPI Driver with DMA for AS5600 encoders; freeze MQTT JSON Schema v1.0 with QoS 0 (telemetry) / QoS 1 (commands) and enforce via CI gates on both firmware and FastAPI.
architecture_decisions.reason: Eliminates SPI bus contention risking 100 ms motor deadline; CI-enforced schema freeze prevents telemetry/command parsing failures across firmware-backend boundary.

architecture_gaps.title: DRV8825 microstepping mode not yet confirmed (1/16 vs 1/256)
architecture_gaps.reason: Affects torque, step-rate headroom, and encoder quantization error; directly impacts tracking accuracy and motor thermal budget.
architecture_gaps.recommended_action: Bench-test both modes with loaded tracker; measure step-loss at max slew rate and encoder quantization; decide before PCB spin.

architecture_gaps.title: TPL5010 watchdog component selection and PCB footprint not finalized
architecture_gaps.reason: External watchdog is critical for OTA rollback reliability; footprint and BOM; must confirm 30 s timeout variant availability and SOT-23 package placement.
architecture_gaps.recommended_action: Order TPL5010 samples; validate 30 s timeout accuracy over temperature; reserve GPIO and footprint on next PCB revision.

architecture_gaps.title: Lock-Free SPI Driver DMA buffer alignment and FreeRTOS notification latency unverified on target silicon
architecture_gaps.reason: DMA requires 4-byte aligned buffers; FreeRTOS task notification latency must fit within 100 ms cycle margin after SPI reads. Silicon validation needed.
architecture_gaps.recommended_action: Implement driver prototype on ESP32-S3 dev kit; measure end-to-end read latency (CS assert -> DMA complete -> Task Notify) over 10k iterations; confirm < 50 µs p99.

agroshield-frost-guard.summary: Execution plan organized into five milestones: (1) Resolve architecture gaps via targeted hardware validation and calibration, (2) Develop and validate ESP32-C3 sensor node firmware including thermal sampling, freeze detection, adaptive LoRaWAN duty cycling, and power management, (3) Build Raspberry Pi 4 gateway ingestion service, Firebase sync, dual-stage ignition logic, and hardware watchdog integration, (4) Implement React operator dashboard with real-time thermal map interpolation, WebGL rendering, node health badges, and lockout reset, (5) Conduct end-to-end system integration testing across orchard extremes at -20C verifying latency, power budget, and fail-safe integrity. Tasks are sequenced to honor strict dependencies: gap resolution before firmware, firmware before gateway integration, gateway before dashboard, and full integration last.

milestones.title: Architecture Gap Resolution & Hardware Validation
milestones.description: Validate LoRaWAN link budget at -20C with SF7, define flame sensor ADC calibration procedure for -20C, and confirm Firebase telemetry compression strategy to meet 1 GB/month egress limit.

milestones.title: ESP32-C3 Sensor Node Firmware Development
milestones.description: Implement MLX90640 1 Hz sampling, 3-sample freeze detection, adaptive LoRaWAN duty cycle (10s/60s/300s), CBOR telemetry encoding (min/mean/max + histogram), deep-sleep power management, and TPS3828 watchdog heartbeat on ESP32-C3.

milestones.title: Raspberry Pi 4 Gateway & Actuation Logic
milestones.description: Build FastAPI UDP/8888 listener with CRC16/CBOR decode, Firebase telemetry write (<2s), dual-node freeze confirmation, dual-stage ignition sequence (GPIO23 pilot 500ms -> GPIO24 flame verify -> GPIO25 main 30s), lockout write, and TPS3828 watchdog heartbeat toggle.

milestones.title: React Operator Dashboard Implementation
milestones.description: Develop Firebase real-time subscription, inverse-distance thermal interpolation onto orchard GeoJSON, WebGL thermal layer at 1 Hz, node health badges (battery/RSSI thresholds), and lockout reset button writing to /safety/lockout.

milestones.title: End-to-End Orchard Integration & -20C Validation
milestones.description: Deploy 10-node representative array across orchard extremes, validate <15s P95 latency, >180-day power budget projection, dual-stage ignition with hardware watchdog fail-safe, and dashboard rendering fidelity at -20C ambient.

tasks.title: Conduct LoRaWAN SF7 RSSI/SNR sweep at -20C across orchard fringe nodes
tasks.description: Deploy 3 ESP32-C3 + SX1262 test nodes at maximum range positions in orchard; place in environmental chamber at -20C; transmit 1000 packets each at SF7/125kHz; log RSSI, SNR, packet loss; compare against link budget model; document SF9 fallback configuration parameters.
related_requirements: LoRaWAN Uplink with Adaptive Duty Cycle
success_criteria: P95 packet delivery success rate >= 95% at all test positions at -20C with SF7
Measured RSSI/SNR margins documented with 3 dB SF7 penalty included
SF9 fallback config (spreading factor, interval, latency) defined and tested if SF7 fails

tasks.title: Define flame sensor ADC calibration procedure for -20C ambient
tasks.description: Test UVTRON UV flame sensor (selected per architecture decision) at -20C in environmental chamber with controlled propane pilot flame present/absent; measure ADC output distribution over 100 samples each; calculate optimal threshold with temperature compensation formula; document calibration steps for production nodes.
success_criteria: ADC threshold value defined that yields zero false negatives (flame present -> ADC > threshold) and zero false positives (flame absent -> ADC < threshold) at -20C
Temperature compensation formula or lookup table documented for -20C to +60C range
Calibration procedure written as step-by-step production test script

tasks.title: Design and validate CBOR telemetry payload compression for Firebase egress limit
tasks.description: Implement candidate CBOR schema encoding thermal_min_c (int16, 0.01C resolution), thermal_mean_c (int16), thermal_max_c (int16), histogram_bins (8 x uint8), battery_v (uint16, mV), rssi_dbm (int8); measure encoded size; simulate 100 nodes at adaptive intervals (10s alert, 60s nominal, 300s deep-sleep) for 30 days; verify projected egress < 1 GB/month; iterate schema if needed.
related_requirements: LoRaWAN Uplink with Adaptive Duty Cycle
Raspberry Pi 4 Gateway Packet Ingestion & Firebase Sync
success_criteria: CBOR payload size <= 80 bytes per telemetry packet
Simulated 30-day egress for 100 nodes <= 900 MB (10% margin under 1 GB limit)
Schema documented with field types, resolutions, and example hex dump

tasks.title: Implement MLX90640 I2C driver and 1 Hz frame capture on ESP32-C3
tasks.description: Write FreeRTOS task initializing MLX90640 via I2C (0x33), configuring 32x24 resolution, 1 Hz refresh rate, and emissivity 0.98; implement double-buffered frame capture with DMA to avoid blocking; validate frame timing jitter < 5 ms over 1 hour at -20C in chamber.
success_criteria: MLX90640 delivers 768-pixel frames at 1.000 Hz +/- 0.005 Hz continuously for 1 hour at -20C
Per-pixel minimum computation completes within 2 ms per frame
I2C error rate < 0.01% over 3600 frames

tasks.title: Implement 3-consecutive-sample freeze detection logic with alert state machine
tasks.description: Code state machine: IDLE -> MONITORING (any pixel <= 0.0C) -> CONFIRMED (3 consecutive MONITORING frames) -> ALERT; on ALERT entry, construct freeze-alert CBOR packet with node_id, timestamp, triggering_pixel_min_c, battery_v, rssi_dbm; transition back to IDLE after 5 consecutive frames with all pixels > 0.5C hysteresis.
success_criteria: Freeze alert triggered within 3.0 +/- 0.1 seconds of sustained sub-zero pixel
No alert triggered for transient single-frame dips (< 3 frames)
Hysteresis prevents chatter: 5 frames > 0.5C required to clear alert

tasks.title: Implement adaptive LoRaWAN duty cycle manager with SX1262 SPI driver
tasks.description: Write SX1262 driver for SF7/125kHz, CRC16, explicit header mode; implement duty cycle manager: ALERT state -> TX every 10s; NOMINAL -> TX telemetry every 60s; DEEP_SLEEP (battery < 3.3V) -> TX every 300s; enforce 1% regulatory limit via rolling 1-hour window; integrate TPS3828 watchdog feed (GPIO toggle every 4s).
related_requirements: LoRaWAN Uplink with Adaptive Duty Cycle
success_criteria: TX interval switches within 1 cycle of state change (alert/nominal/deep-sleep)
Rolling 1-hour duty cycle never exceeds 1.0% (measured via GPIO TX_EN pulse counting)
TPS3828 watchdog heartbeat toggles at 4s interval visible on oscilloscope

tasks.title: Implement deep-sleep power management with supercapacitor charge control
tasks.description: Code LDO + supercapacitor management: solar MPPT sampling every 60s, battery voltage ADC every 10s; enter DEEP_SLEEP (ESP32 deep sleep, SX1262 sleep, MLX90640 power-down) when battery < 3.3V; wake on RTC alarm for scheduled TX or solar current > 50mA; measure average current draw over 24h at -20C.
success_criteria: Deep-sleep current <= 15 uA measured at -20C
Active TX burst (120 mA for 400 ms) measured via shunt
24-hour average current <= 1.2 mA at -20C with 2.5h equivalent solar insolation

tasks.title: Integrate and validate full ESP32-C3 node firmware on bench at -20C
tasks.description: Flash complete firmware to 5 ESP32-C3 nodes with MLX90640, SX1262, LiFePO4, solar; place in -20C chamber; run 72-hour soak test logging freeze detection latency, LoRaWAN packet receipt at gateway, battery voltage trajectory, watchdog heartbeat; verify all success criteria from tasks 4-7.
related_requirements: LoRaWAN Uplink with Adaptive Duty Cycle
success_criteria: All 5 nodes detect freeze within 30s and transmit alert at 10s interval
Gateway receives >95% of alert packets at -20C (validates task-1 link budget)
Battery voltage decline projects >180 days lifetime
TPS3828 watchdog heartbeat continuous on all nodes

tasks.title: Implement FastAPI UDP/8888 listener with CRC16 validation and CBOR decode
tasks.description: Write Python FastAPI service binding UDP/8888; implement CRC16-CCITT validation on received packets; decode CBOR payload per schema from task-3; extract node_id, timestamp, thermal_min_c, battery_v, rssi_dbm; handle malformed packets with structured logging; unit test with captured LoRaWAN traces.
related_requirements: Raspberry Pi 4 Gateway Packet Ingestion & Firebase Sync
success_criteria: Service processes 100 packets/sec sustained with <2ms per-packet latency
CRC16 validation catches 100% of corrupted test vectors
CBOR decode yields correct fields for all schema variants

tasks.title: Implement Firebase telemetry write with <2s latency guarantee
tasks.description: Integrate Firebase Admin SDK; write telemetry to /nodes/{node_id}/telemetry with server timestamp; implement async batch write with 500ms flush interval; measure end-to-end latency from UDP receipt to Firebase write completion; implement retry with exponential backoff on network errors.
related_requirements: Raspberry Pi 4 Gateway Packet Ingestion & Firebase Sync
success_criteria: P99 latency from UDP receipt to Firebase write <= 2.0 seconds
Zero data loss over 24h continuous operation with simulated network partitions
Firebase writes respect Spark plan connection limits

tasks.title: Implement dual-node freeze confirmation and neighbor graph logic
tasks.description: Load orchard node adjacency GeoJSON; on freeze-alert receipt, mark node in alert state; evaluate if >=2 neighboring nodes (per adjacency) are simultaneously in alert state within 30s window; trigger ignition sequence only on dual confirmation; clear alert state after 5 minutes without new alert packets.
success_criteria: Ignition triggered only when >=2 adjacent nodes alert within 30s
Single-node alert never triggers ignition
Alert state auto-clears after 5 minutes of silence

tasks.title: Implement dual-stage ignition sequence: GPIO23 pilot 500ms -> GPIO24 flame verify -> GPIO25 main 30s
tasks.description: Write GPIO control module using lgpio; on dual confirmation: assert GPIO23 (pilot) for 500ms; poll GPIO24 ADC (via MCP3008 SPI ADC) for 2s waiting for >2.5V (threshold from task-2); if confirmed, assert GPIO25 (main) for 30s; else de-assert GPIO23, write lockout to /safety/lockout with triggering_nodes and timestamp; implement 10min lockout enforcement.
success_criteria: Pilot valve opens for 500ms +/- 10ms measured on oscilloscope
Flame verification window 2.0s +/- 0.1s with ADC threshold from task-2
Main valve opens for 30s +/- 0.5s only after flame confirm
Lockout written to Firebase within 1s of flame failure

tasks.title: Integrate TPS3828 hardware watchdog heartbeat and valve fail-safe
tasks.description: Configure TPS3828 on Pi GPIO (watchdog input) and MOSFET driver board enable lines; implement Pi heartbeat task toggling GPIO at 4s interval; verify TPS3828 forces both valve MOSFET gates low when heartbeat absent >5s; test Pi crash (kill -9) and power loss scenarios; confirm lockout persists in Firebase after power restore.

Lockout state in Firebase survives Pi power cycle

tasks.title: Integrate catalytic heater control for relay enclosure at -20C
tasks.description: Implement battery voltage monitor reading from ADC; enable 2W catalytic heater via GPIO/MOSFET when battery >3.4V and ambient (via MLX90640 die temp) < -10C; disable when battery <3.3V or ambient > -5C; verify enclosure temperature stays > -10C at -20C ambient in chamber test.

tasks.title: Implement Firebase real-time subscription and telemetry ingestion in React
tasks.description: Initialize Firebase JS SDK; subscribe to /nodes/+/telemetry and /safety/lockout; implement normalized telemetry store with node_id key; handle reconnection and backfill; parse thermal_min_c, battery_v, rssi_dbm, timestamp; unit test with Firebase emulator.

tasks.title: Implement inverse-distance thermal interpolation onto orchard GeoJSON grid
tasks.description: Load orchard GeoJSON with node positions; implement inverse-distance weighting (power=2) interpolation of thermal_min_c onto 10m grid; handle edge nodes with single-neighbor fallback; update interpolation at 1 Hz on new telemetry; output Float32Array for WebGL texture upload.

tasks.title: Implement WebGL thermal layer rendering at 1 Hz with color scale

tasks.title: Implement node health badges (battery/RSSI thresholds) and lockout reset button

tasks.title: Validate end-to-end latency <15s P95 at -20C with induced freeze events
tasks.description: Use calibrated cold plates to induce controlled freeze events at 3 nodes simultaneously; measure timestamp from MLX90640 sample (logged on node) to Firebase write (server timestamp); repeat 50 times at -20C ambient; compute P95 latency; verify <15s.

tasks.title: Validate dual-stage ignition with hardware watchdog fail-safe at -20C
tasks.description: Trigger freeze event at >=2 adjacent nodes; verify pilot valve opens 500ms, flame sensor confirms (ADC > threshold from task-2), main valve opens 30s; then test failure: block flame, verify immediate de-assert and 10min lockout; test Pi crash (kill -9) during ignition, verify TPS3828 closes both valves within 100ms; test power loss, verify lockout persists after reboot.

tasks.title: Validate 180-day power budget projection via 14-day accelerated soak at -20C

tasks.title: Define rotating-sector wear-leveling algorithm for ESP32-S3 flash circular buffer
tasks.description: Design wear-leveling strategy dividing flash into N sectors (e.g., 4KB each), rotating write pointer across sectors on wrap-around; calculate sector count needed for 10Hz write rate over 2-year target lifetime given ESP32-S3 flash endurance (100k cycles/sector). success_criteria: Wear-leveling algorithm documented with sector size, rotation policy, and endurance calculation
Estimated flash lifetime exceeds 2 years at 10Hz sustained write rate

success_criteria: MQTT payload JSON schema published with deduplication key fields
FastAPI validation pseudocode for duplicate rejection documented

tasks.title: Model energy budget for flash writes and Wi-Fi reconnect cycles
tasks.description: Measure or source ESP32-S3 flash write current (mA) and duration (ms) per 4KB sector write; measure Wi-Fi radio active current and typical reconnect latency; compute energy per telemetry packet buffered and per reconnect attempt; define maximum outage duration before deep-sleep entry to meet battery-life target.
success_criteria: Energy model spreadsheet with per-packet flash write energy, per-reconnect Wi-Fi energy, and daily budget
Maximum tolerable outage duration before deep-sleep documented

success_criteria: SensorTask runs at 10Hz ±1% jitter on oscilloscope GPIO toggle

success_criteria: BufferTask writes 10Hz packets continuously for 24 hours without sector overrun
Power-cycle test: buffered packets retained and replayed correctly after reboot

tasks.title: Implement MQTT over TLS client with QoS 1 and automatic replay logic

success_criteria: MQTT QoS 1 publish succeeds within 200ms when Wi-Fi connected

Reconnect backoff respects energy model max outage duration

tasks.title: Implement gateway Wi-Fi state machine and deep-sleep entry

success_criteria: Deep-sleep current < 100µA measured on multimeter

Buffer pointers survive deep-sleep/wake cycle intact

Task-8 (gateway MQTT) depends on both Task-5 (sensor->arbiter->gateway flow) and Task-6 (watchdog recovery events) because gateway ingests diagnostics from both.
Task-9 (NVS buffer) and Task-10 (Wi-Fi handler) are sequential: buffer must exist before reconnect drain logic can use it.
Task-11 (integration) cannot start until Task-7 (watchdog false-positive guard) and Task-10 (Wi-Fi handler) are done, as they modify arbiter and gateway respectively.
Arbiter priority ceiling protocol (Task-4) is a prerequisite for Task-5 sensor deadline guarantee; verify with FreeRTOS runtime stats before soak test.
Watchdog timeout (50ms) plus transaction-in-progress guard (Task-7) must exceed worst-case I2C transaction (measured in Task-2) plus margin; adjust if Task-2 reveals >30ms transactions.

test-p3-g-stage-failure.summary: Execution plan for Fault Tolerant Hub spanning four milestones: (1) Hardware bring-up and sensor I2C validation, (2) ESP32 FreeRTOS firmware implementing ring buffer, MQTT client, and Wi-Fi manager with overflow/QoS/time-sync policies, (3) Cloud FastAPI ingest service and PostgreSQL schema deployment, (4) End-to-end integration, soak testing, and battery-life profiling. Tasks are ordered by strict technical dependencies — sensor I2C must work before gateway firmware can enqueue frames; ring buffer and Wi-Fi manager must be stable before MQTT publish path is tested; cloud ingest and DB must be live before end-to-end flow verification.

test-a-clean-pipeline.summary: Execution plan for the Clean Solar Tracker project, phased over 4 weeks. Phase 1 (Week 1) resolves critical hardware decisions (DRV8825 microstepping, TPL5010 watchdog) and freezes the MQTT JSON Schema v1.0 with CI gates. Phase 2 (Week 2) builds the lock-free dual-CS SPI encoder driver and validates DMA/notification latency on target silicon. Phase 3 (Week 3) implements the four FreeRTOS tasks (dual motor control, sun tracking, telemetry/OTA) and deep-sleep power management with sequenced load-switch control. Phase 4 (Week 4) delivers the FastAPI/PostgreSQL cloud backend, end-to-end integration testing, OTA rollback verification, and 24-hour idle power validation.

DMA buffers pass 4-byte alignment static assertion
Dual-CS read sequence completes without bus contention

related_requirements: Dual-axis motor control with FreeRTOS tasks
success_criteria: Task executes deterministically every 100 ms ±10 µs jitter
Step/dir pulses generated within 20 µs of encoder read completion
Watchdog kick issued after both azimuth and elevation reads (coordinated with task_motor_el)

tasks.title: Implement elevation motor control FreeRTOS task (100 ms cycle)

success_criteria: Task executes deterministically every 100 ms ±10 µs jitter
Step/dir pulses generated within 20 µs of encoder read completion

tasks.title: Implement sun-position tracking FreeRTOS task (60 s cycle)

success_criteria: Task wakes within 1 ms of RTC alarm interrupt

tasks.title: Implement telemetry/OTA FreeRTOS task (30 s cycle) with MQTT client

success_criteria: Sequenced enable/disable order verified on oscilloscope (motor first, Wi-Fi after 1 ms; reverse on sleep)
RTC alarm interrupt wakes ESP32 from deep-sleep within 1 ms
I2C sensor reads complete without bus errors during active window

Rollback triggered when kick withheld (counter decrements, partition switches)

success_criteria: 100 ms motor cycle deadline met for 3600 consecutive cycles

tasks.title: End-to-end telemetry latency test (MQTT publish → PostgreSQL commit)
tasks.description: Instrument firmware and backend timestamps; trigger 100 telemetry publishes at 30 s intervals; measure end-to-end latency; confirm P99 ≤5 s.
related_requirements: MQTT telemetry and OTA command interface
success_criteria: P99 latency ≤5 s across 100 samples
Zero telemetry drops (sequence numbers continuous)
Latency breakdown: Wi-Fi <1 s, MQTT <0.5 s, FastAPI <2 s, PG commit <1 s

tasks.title: Tracking accuracy validation under clear-sky conditions
tasks.description: Deploy tracker outdoors; run for 30 min warm-up; log encoder angles vs reference solar position (NREL SPA calculator) every 60 s for 2 hours; compute absolute angular error; confirm ≤1°.
success_criteria: Absolute angular error ≤1° after 30 min warm-up
Error distribution: median <0.5°, max <1°
No hard-limit collisions during test

tasks.title: OTA update reliability test (30-day simulated field test)
tasks.description: Execute 10 OTA cycles: trigger via MQTT command (QoS 1); verify download, signature, partition write, reboot, watchdog kick, boot-counter increment; induce 3 forced failures (power cut during write, bad signature, watchdog timeout) and confirm rollback; measure downtime per update.

planning_notes: Task-1 (DRV8825 microstepping decision) must complete before PCB spin; it gates motor driver configuration for both axes.

Critical path reflects longest sequential dependency chain: hardware decision → schema → SPI driver → motor tasks → sun task → telemetry task → deep-sleep → watchdog → full integration → firmware CI → backend → E2E latency → accuracy → OTA → idle power.
